why: The reconstruction fixture. It carries the three cases that break a naive rebuild: a word listed at two positions (`the` at 3 and 5), a gap no word claims (position 6), and an astral character (U+1F9EA) before every span the offset tests use. `text_hash` is recorded here and asserted byte for byte, so a normalization change cannot pass unnoticed.

work.title: A fixture abstract for the offset walk
